title: Asset status changed to completed
description: This event occurs when an asset reaches its maturity date and its status changes to `COMPLETED` with product interest management. The quotas with available units are split into pages, one event per page. Pages can arrive out of order and more than once, with the same `event_id` for the same page, so consumers should deduplicate by `external_quota_id`.

external_asset_id.title: External asset ID
external_asset_id.description: Unique asset short identifier defined by Pismo.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number of this event, starting at 1. Each page lists a different part of the asset's quotas.

total_pages.title: Total pages
total_pages.description: Number of pages published for this asset completion. The asset is fully described once every page from 1 to `total_pages` is received. An asset with no quota left has a single page with an empty `quotas` list.

page_size.title: Page size
page_size.description: Maximum number of quotas in a page. Every page has `page_size` quotas except the last one, which can have fewer.

total_quotas.title: Total quotas
total_quotas.description: Number of completed quotas listed for this asset across all pages. It equals the sum of the quotas of every page from 1 to `total_pages`. Quotas with no available units are not listed.

quotas.title: List of quotas
quotas.description: Completed quotas of this page, each with its final position at maturity.

quota.title: Quota
quota.description: Completed quota with its final position at maturity.

external_quota_id.title: External quota ID
external_quota_id.description: Unique quota identifier defined by client.

account_id.title: Account identifier
account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within client organization.

issuing_date.title: Issuing date
issuing_date.description: Date asset was effectively issued by client.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Date asset matures and its quotas are completed.

issued_units.title: Issued units
issued_units.description: Number of units issued for the quota.

available_units.title: Available units
available_units.description: Number of units the quota still holds at maturity, after redemptions.

gross_unit_value.title: Gross unit value
gross_unit_value.description: Gross unit value of the final accrual, the one of the day before maturity. It is the asset unit value when the asset was issued after that day.

gross_balance.title: Gross balance
gross_balance.description: Gross position of the quota: `available_units` times `gross_unit_value`, truncated to 2 decimals.

net_unit_value.title: Net unit value
net_unit_value.description: Net unit value of the final accrual: the gross unit value minus the IR and IOF unit values.

net_balance.title: Net balance
net_balance.description: Net position of the quota: `gross_balance` minus the `amount` of every tax.

taxes.title: List of taxes
taxes.description: Taxes on the quota position, always one IR and one IOF entry.

rate.title: Tax rate
rate.description: Tax rate, as a percentage. It is 0 when the tax does not apply.

unit_value.title: Tax unit value
unit_value.description: Tax per unit of the final accrual.

amount.title: Tax amount
amount.description: Tax on the quota position: `available_units` times `unit_value`, truncated to 2 decimals.
